DEPLOYABLE.definition: usable by any deployable candidate / feature / actuator; must never depend on target anomaly labels, anomaly scores, or oracle outcomes

ORACLE_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY.definition: usable ONLY for oracle diagnostic targets and diagnostic metrics; never a deployment input; never used to fit/select/calibrate any candidate

firewall.mechanism: code-level Firewall (pb7_p0_common.py); deployable computation must call assert_deployable_clean() which raises FIREWALL_VIOLATION if any anomaly (oracle-only) file was read on that path

leakage_rule: if any deployable candidate directly or indirectly uses target-bad / anomaly information, it is immediately marked LEAKAGE_INVALID
